alerts.headline: BDL, BEL, other defence shares gain up to 3% as MoD seeks 20% rise in capex in Budget 2027
second_order_candidates: Winner: Indian defence PSUs and suppliers (BEL, BDL, HAL, Mazagon Dock): a 20% higher capital outlay ask means a larger domestic order pipeline.
Losers: none clear - a ministry request is not an allocation. If the ask is cut, the move reverses. Foreign OEMs lose only if the extra spend favours domestic buyers, and that is not stated.
Catalyst: scheduled - Union Budget 2027 (due about 1 February 2027, date not yet fixed); an MoD request is a proposal, so the allocation is the real event, and it is about 10 weeks away.
Thesis fit: none (not drafted: a ministry ask is not an allocation and no dated source gives a firm outcome yet)
